poses.tablet: Skellywix taps a violet tablet. A white flower headband crowns her ice-blue bob, and pink hairpins frame her visible blue eye.
poses.delighted: Skellywix smiles and waves a white-gloved hand, with the other tucked against her cheek.
poses.treat: Skellywix lifts a crescent biscuit to her lips and holds the paper bag against her white apron.
poses.nap: Skellywix sits with her legs tucked to one side. Her blue eye is closed, and her cheek rests on her folded hands.

workflow.compare_builds: A on the left, B on the right. Spot the difference.
workflow.verify_checksum: Bring your own reference hash. A file can’t vouch for itself.

case.inspect: Header read. Size, format, and fingerprint are in the ledger.
case.match: Checksum matches your reference. Keep the source of that reference handy.
case.mismatch: Hash mismatch. Save the reference with your notes.
case.mixed: This one matches. The earlier mismatch still counts in this case.
case.identical: Same SHA-256 on both files. No difference showed up in this check.
case.different: The files differ. The side-by-side shows which fields.
case.critique: Second opinion just landed. Check the entries it cites, not the tone.
case.export: Evidence exported. Keep the file with your case notes.
